origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(slam))

f <- tempfile()
m <- simple_triplet_matrix(i=c(1,2,1), j=c(1,1,2), v=c(1.5,2,3), nrow=2, ncol=2)
write_stm_CLUTO(m, f)
cat(paste(readLines(f), collapse = "\n"), "\n")

translation.description: Write a simple triplet matrix in CLUTO sparse format.
translation.details: Write a simple triplet matrix in CLUTO sparse format.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from slam import simple_triplet_matrix, write_stm_CLUTO
path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "m"
m = simple_triplet_matrix([1, 2, 1], [1, 1, 2], [1.5, 2, 3], 2, 2)
write_stm_CLUTO(m, path)
print("\n".join(path.read_text().splitlines()))
